message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑use “Paris Trip Planner”** you can copy into your notes app or print out.  
Feel free to tweak dates, add personal interests, or drop sections that don’t fit your style – this is meant to be a flexible framework rather than a rigid script.

---

## 📅 Sample Itinerary – 7 Days in Paris  

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|--------|
| **Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation** | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle / Orly → take RER B + metro to hotel. Check‑in, unpack. | Walk along the Seine, cross Pont Neuf, grab croissants from *Le Pain Quotidien*. | Dinner near Montmartre (*Café des Deux Moulins*). Sunset walk up Sacré‑Coeur. |
| **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | Louvre Museum (early entry ticket) | Lunch at Café Marly, then stroll through Palais Royal gardens. Visit Notre-Dame (exterior only due to restoration). | River cruise on the Seine (night tour). Light show over Eiffel Tower. |
| **Day 3 - Art & Culture** | Musée d’Orsay (Impressionist masterpieces). | Picnic in Tuileries Garden, then explore Jardin du Luxembourg. | Opera Garnier backstage tour or a classical concert. |
| **Day 4 – Modern & Shopping** | Centre Pompidou (modern art). | Explore Le Marais district—boutiques, vintage shops, Place des Vosges. | Dinner at *L’As du Fallafel* (for a quick bite) followed by drinks at *Bar Hemingway* (if you’re feeling fancy). |
| **Day 5 – Palace & Gardens** | Versailles day trip (train RER C). Tour palace rooms, Hall of Mirrors, and expansive gardens. | Return to Paris, relax at café near your hotel. | Optional jazz club in Saint-Germain-des-Prés. |
| **Day 6 – Hidden Gems** | Canal Saint-Martin bike ride (rent a Vélo à la Carte). | Visit Marché aux Puces de Saint-Ouen flea market. | Casual dinner at *Bouillon Chartier*, then late‑night stroll across Pont Alexandre III. |
| **Day 7 – Departure/Last Minute** | Pack, last coffee at *Angelina* (chocolate hot chocolate). | Quick stop at Arc de Triomphe (top view). | Head back to airport via RER A/B. |

> **Tip:** Buy a multi‑day Metro/RER pass (Navigo Découverte) for unlimited rides between 9 am–10 pm each day. For early morning trains before 8 am, use single‑ticket fares.

---

## 🏨 Accommodation Options

| Budget | Neighborhood | Highlights | Approx nightly cost (€) |
|--------|--------------|------------|--------------------------|
| €50–€80 | Latin Quarter | Close to Sorbonne, cafés, student vibe | 55 |
| €90–€150 | Île de la Cité | Near Notre‑Dame, easy access to many sights | 120 |
| €160+ | Champs‑Élysées | Luxury hotels, high-end boutiques | 220 |
| Airbnb | Various neighborhoods | Local feel, often cheaper per night | Varies |

### Booking Tips
- Book well in advance for peak season (May–September).
- Look for refundable rates when possible.
- Use filters for “free cancellation” on major OTAs.

---

## 🚆 Getting Around

| Mode | Cost (per adult) | Notes |
|------|------------------|-------|
| Métro/Subway | €1.90 per ride (single ticket) | Unlimited daily passes available (€14.70/day). |
| Bus | Same fare as métro | Good for scenic routes. |
| Taxi/Uber | Starts ~12 €, plus distance/time | Avoid during rush hour. |
| Bicycle Rental (Vélib') | €1.75/hour | Great for short trips, especially around parks. |
| Walking | Free | Many central districts are pedestrian-friendly. |

> **Pro tip:** Download the Citymapper or Moovit apps—they’ll help navigate transfers quickly.

---

## 🍽️ Food & Drink Must‑Dos

| Dish | Where to Try | Why |
|------|-------------|-----|
| Croissant & Café au lait | *Du Pain et des Idées* (Canal Saint Martin) | Authentic flaky pastry. |
| Escargot | *Le Relais de l'Entrecôte* | Traditional French dish. |
| Macarons | Ladurée or Pierre Hermé | Iconic sweet treat. |
| Cheese platter | Fromagerie Barthélémy | Wide selection of regional cheeses. |
| Wine tasting | La Cave à Michel | Learn about Bordeaux vs Burgundy. |
| Street food | Rue Cler Market | Fresh baguettes, cheese, charcuterie. |

#### Dining Etiquette
- Keep hands visible on table (rest elbows off surface).
- Wait until everyone has been served before starting.
- Tip 15%–20% in restaurants unless service charge already added.

---

## 🎟️ Tickets & Reservations

| Attraction | Ticket Type | Price (€) | Best Time to Go |
|------------|-------------|-----------|-----------------|
| Louvre | Standard | 17 | Early morning (open 9 am) |
| Musée d'Orsay | Standard | 16 | Mid‑afternoon |
| Eiffel Tower | Summit | 25.90 | Late afternoon/evening |
| Versailles | Full Pass | 30 | Weekdays avoid crowds |
| Catacombs | Guided | 23 | Evenings after museum hours |

> **Advance purchase** saves queues. Most venues accept mobile tickets now.

---

## 🌍 Practical Information

| Topic | Details |
|-------|---------|
| Visa | EU citizens no visa required. Non‑EU may need Schengen visa. |
| Currency | Euro (€). Credit cards widely accepted; carry small cash for markets. |
| Language | Basic French phrases appreciated. English spoken in most tourist zones. |
| Safety | Pickpocket risk in crowded areas. Keep valuables secure. |
| Power Plug | France uses type E sockets, 230 V supply voltage. Bring adapter. |
| Weather (June) | Mild temperatures (~18°C–24°C). Pack light layers, umbrella. |

---

## ✈️ Suggested Packing List

- Comfortable walking shoes (you'll cover >10 km/day)
- Lightweight jacket/blazer (evening breezes)
- Reusable water bottle (Hydraboard or similar)
- Portable phone charger
- Small backpack/backpack bag for day tours
- Travel insurance documents
- Copies of passport & visas

---

## 🔄 Customizing Your Plan

| Interest | Alternative Activity |
|----------|----------------------|
| Photography | Photographic walk at Parc des Buttes-Chaumont |
| Nightlife | Clubbing in Pigalle or rooftop bars at Hôtel Raphael |
| Family Friendly | Disneyland Paris (full day) or Aquarium de Paris |
| Culinary Focus | Cooking class at L’École Gourmande |
| History Buff | Sainte Chapelle, Conciergerie, Panthéon |

Just swap one activity per day according to what excites you most!

---

Enjoy your adventure! If you'd like more detail on any section—transport hacks, restaurant reservations, or even a printable PDF version—just let me know. Bon voyage!
